_source: SIA 265:2021, clause 4.5 (Bemessungssituation Brand), Tabelle 13 and equations (48) to (51) -- transcribed by hand from the German edition, SIA265-2021-DE.pdf pp. 38-40, Tabelle 13 and (51) read off a render of p. 40 (the table's rows and the sign of (51) do not extract as text). Checked against the French edition, SIA265-2021-FR.pdf (Tableau 13, «Vitesse de combustion théorique»).
_note: The rows of Tabelle 13 are the norm's own: `woods` names which choice of the engineer each row is read for -- `softwood` is any grade SIA 265 lists as Nadelholz, `beech`, `oak` and `cladding` are asked of him --, `families` which family of Tabelle 8/9 (`Vollholz` stands for Vollholz, keilgezinktes Vollholz and Balkenschichtholz); Holzwerkstoffe are «siehe Lignum-Dokumentation Brandschutz» and absent here. The footnote 1) of the table (glued products: «Bei Einsatz von im Brandfall beständigen Klebstofftypen») is carried as `adhesive_note`.
